verdict.rationale: 2FAS documentation states it generates TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and the browser extensions, which covers two of the story's non-standard token types. The 'token customization' feature refers only to groups, badges, icons and labels, not OTP parameters, so custom periods and digit lengths are unevidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of configurable periods and digit lengths, documentation of HOTP counter handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of Steam Guard/HOTP support.
